reviews.review_description: The game got me at the jump scare which was really nice  , the atmosphere and sounds all is good, but i finished it very fast and needed more content and harder puzzles. Also controllers would be better as hands and grapping lot of useless things would make it more realistic and harder not knowing if this item would help or not 👌overall great experience hope for more content later

developer_response.body: Thanks for playing and for the great suggestions! Our games are intentionally short & polished experiences. Exciting news: 2 new rooms with harder puzzles are coming soon! Stay tuned!

reviews.review_description: I played the game for a few minutes and was able to solve the puzzles very fast. I suggest adding more challenges to make it more fun. Also, the texts are very blurry, maybe it is due to my Quest 3s's low resolution, I'm not sure.

developer_response.body: Thanks for the review! You're absolutely right about the puzzles and the text. Good news: we're dropping an update in two days to fix those blurry texts! Also, we've got a plan to add more and more challenges over time, so stay tuned. Thanks for the support
